parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of decorated __init__ methods not being documented by modifying the autodoc extension to unwrap decorated methods.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding a conditional check and assignment within the existing method, which could be slightly confusing.
